reason: ReDoS in effect Schema.TemplateLiteral decoding. effect is only a dependency of @prisma/config, which the Prisma CLI uses to load our own prisma.config.ts (generate, migrate deploy); the API process never loads it (the generated client and @prisma/adapter-pg do not import @prisma/config or effect) and no request input is ever decoded by it. prisma is a runtime dependency of @hg/api only so the image can run migrate deploy, seed and the localities script (spec 9b.1); those commands read only our own config file. npm's only 'fix' is a downgrade to Prisma 6. Re-check when Prisma ships effect >=3.22.1.
